{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnetic pulse siphon''' was a piece of technology. It could be used by [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgers]] to make micro-adjustments to [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chips]] to increase the number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the chip. They typically cost around 5,000 credits.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
